name: reply-sheet
description: Reply to long Claude answers item by item, in a pane beside the chat or in VS Code. Haiku builds the reply file; only answered items go back to Claude.

icons.title: Button icons
icons.description: Nerd Font icons on the buttons. on: always (needs a Nerd Font as the terminal font, else empty boxes). auto: only in Ghostty and WezTerm, which ship the icons. off: never.
